funnels.note: 93 fully specified meanings on a 11-axis grid

verbs.means: Bring a read library into the workspace from a URL, an SRA accession or staging.
verbs.canonical_name: Import FASTQ/SRA File as Reads from Staging Area

verbs.means: Measure read quality and report it. Produces no new data object.
verbs.canonical_name: Assess Read Quality with FastQC - v0.12.1

verbs.means: Trim, filter or error-correct a read library. Consumes reads and produces reads.
Combine or divide read libraries without changing any read.
Rewrite a read library in another format or schema version.
verbs.canonical_name: Convert Legacy Read Library to New Read Library

verbs.means: Bring contigs into the workspace from a FASTA file or an assembly file.
verbs.canonical_name: Import FASTA File as Assembly from Staging Area

verbs.means: Build contigs from sequencing reads.
Correct an assembly using the reads it was built from.
Select a subset of contigs by length or by membership.
Measure assembly quality and report it.
verbs.canonical_name: Assess Quality of Assemblies with QUAST - v4.4

verbs.means: Bring an annotated genome into the workspace from GenBank or GFF plus FASTA.
verbs.canonical_name: Import GenBank File as Genome from Staging Area

verbs.means: Assign protein domain families to a genome's features.
verbs.canonical_name: Annotate Domains in a GenomeSet - v1.7.1

verbs.means: Call genes on a sequence and assign functions to them.
Find sequences resembling a query and return them as a feature set.
Group a metagenome assembly's contigs into candidate genomes.
Combine or edit bin sets to improve them.
verbs.canonical_name: Optimize Bacterial or Archaeal Binned Contigs using DAS Tool - v1.1.2

verbs.means: Score bin completeness and contamination, and optionally filter on the score.
verbs.canonical_name: Assess Genome Quality with CheckM - v1.0.18

verbs.means: Publish each bin as a standalone assembly.
verbs.canonical_name: Extract Bins as Assemblies from BinnedContigs - v1.0.2

verbs.means: Assign taxonomy to reads, contigs, bins or genomes.
Reduce a community to a taxonomic or functional abundance matrix.
Bring a metabolic model into the workspace from SBML, TSV or Excel.
verbs.canonical_name: Import TSV/XLS/SBML File as an FBAModel from Staging Area

verbs.means: Bring a growth medium into the workspace from a file.
verbs.canonical_name: Import Media file (TSV/Excel) from Staging Area

verbs.means: Bring a phenotype set into the workspace from a file.
verbs.canonical_name: Import TSV File as Phenotype Set from Staging Area

verbs.means: Reconstruct a metabolic model from an annotated genome or metagenome.
Add reactions until a model grows on a medium.
Change a model's reactions or compounds by hand.
Change a growth medium's composition.
Solve a model for flux on a medium, with or without omics constraints.
Simulate growth of a model against a phenotype set.
Report the difference between two models or two flux solutions.
Bring an expression, amplicon or abundance matrix into the workspace from a file.
verbs.canonical_name: Import Amplicon Matrix from TSV/FASTA File in Staging Area

verbs.means: Build an aligner index over a reference genome.
Map reads onto a reference and produce an alignment.
Measure alignment quality and report it.
verbs.canonical_name: Assess Reads Alignment Quality using Qualimap - v2.2.1

verbs.means: Turn alignments into per-feature expression values.
Contrast expression between conditions.
verbs.canonical_name: Create Differential Expression Matrix using DESeq2 - v1.20.0

verbs.means: Group features or conditions by expression similarity.
Test a feature set for over-represented functions.
verbs.canonical_name: Functional Enrichment for GO Terms - v1.0.8

verbs.means: Filter, normalise, rarefy, impute or re-key a matrix. Consumes a matrix and produces a matrix.
Compute a correlation matrix within or between matrices.
verbs.canonical_name: Compute Correlation Matrix Between Two Matrices

verbs.means: Reduce a matrix to an ordination.
Run a statistical test over a matrix and its sample attributes.
Turn a correlation matrix into a network.
Build or trim a multiple sequence alignment.
Build a phylogeny, or place genomes into an existing one.
Compute orthologous groups across a set of genomes.
Report similarity between genomes or proteomes.
Call sequence variants of a population against a reference.
Find and characterise viral sequence in an assembly.
Group objects into a set, or slice one. Produces no new science.
Attach metadata or access control to a sample set.
Bring an object the vocabulary has no specific verb for into the workspace.
verbs.canonical_name: Import Chemical Abundance Matrix from CSV/Excel/TSV File in Staging Area

verbs.means: Write an object out of the workspace.
verbs.canonical_name: Export Data Object To Staging Area

verbs.means: Render an object as a report. Produces no data object.

groups.reads: getting sequencing reads into a usable state
groups.assembly: turning reads into contigs and judging the result
groups.annotation: naming what is on a sequence
groups.binning: separating a metagenome assembly into genomes
groups.alignment: mapping reads onto a reference and judging the result
groups.expression: RNA-seq from alignment to differential expression
groups.matrix: generic operations on an abundance or expression matrix
groups.comparative: alignments, trees, pangenomes and genome comparison

non_tasks.name: object_shuffler
non_tasks.means: Copies or renames an object without changing it. Accepts so many types it is not a workflow step.

non_tasks.name: no_op
non_tasks.means: Declares neither a typed input nor a typed output nor a service method.

family_means.sequence_data: The payload is sequence. Anything a read mapper, an assembler or a homology search can be pointed at.
family_means.sequence_object: Assembled sequence with stable identity, as opposed to reads. The slot an annotator, a binner or a classifier accepts.
family_means.feature_container: Names genomic features. The slot a feature set operation or an enrichment accepts.
family_means.modelling_object: Part of a metabolic reconstruction. The slot a modelling utility or an exporter accepts.
family_means.genome_group: A named collection of genomes, or a structure derived from one that implies it. The phylogenomics tools accept a GenomeSet or the Tree built from it interchangeably.
family_means.query_source: Somewhere a homology search or an aligner can read query sequences from, whatever object holds them.
family_means.table_object: A table with sample and feature axes, or something derived from one.

dispositions.name: typed_io
dispositions.means: Carries a workspace type. The type graph already models it, so it is not configuration at all.

dispositions.name: object_name
dispositions.means: Names the object the app will write. Metasmith names its own outputs from the plan, so nothing supplies this.

dispositions.name: object_metadata
dispositions.means: A label or description attached to the output object for a human reading the workspace.
dispositions.home: nowhere -- a metasmith run records provenance instead

dispositions.name: input_metadata
dispositions.means: A property of the input data rather than of the method. It belongs on the data type as an axis, which is where the same fact stops being asked for once per app.

dispositions.name: report_style
dispositions.means: How the app renders its report. A workflow that asks for a typed product does not care.

dispositions.name: handled_by_engine
dispositions.means: A path into staging or a workspace reference. Metasmith carries the file itself and its lineage, so the pointer has nothing to point at.

dispositions.name: passthrough
dispositions.means: A raw command line the app hands to its tool unread. A config blob may carry it, but nothing can validate it.

dispositions.name: knob
dispositions.means: Changes what the method computes. This is what a task's config type holds.

common.name: minimum_contig_length
common.means: Discard a contig shorter than this. Declared by assemble, bin, filter_assembly, classify_taxa and identify_virus.

common.name: e_value
common.means: The expectation cutoff a homology search reports down to.

common.name: bitscore
common.means: The bit score cutoff a homology search reports down to.

common.name: minimum_length
common.means: Discard a sequence shorter than this. Declared by annotate, classify_taxa, clean_reads and identify_virus, which is four tasks asking one question four ways.

common.name: minimum_depth
common.means: Require this much read coverage before making a call.

common.name: media_supplement_list
common.means: Compounds added to the medium before a model is solved. Declared identically by build_model, gapfill_model, predict_phenotype and run_fba.

common.name: custom_bound_list
common.means: Flux bounds overriding the model's own, shared by the same four modelling tasks.

common.name: target_reaction
common.means: The reaction a modelling task optimises or tests.

common.name: minimum_target_flux
common.means: The flux the target reaction must reach for a solution to count.

common.name: method
common.means: Which algorithm variant a generic matrix or clustering operation runs.

common.name: dimension
common.means: Whether a matrix operation applies to rows or to columns.
